title: Parameter-variant screen: same indicators under varied settings, each variant a named independent hypothesis
type: signal-quality measurement only; no trade management, no stop, no fees, no capital, no live
goal: which setting precedes the start of the rise (rise_start_coverage is the most important metric)

time_split.rule: rank & choose variants from train only; freeze in a separate commit BEFORE reading holdout

outcome_definition.reference_price: close of the decision bar i

measurement_model.interpretation_note: Faithful two-track realisation of the paper: (T1) STRUCTURE-family variants (MSS/FVG/SFP parameter variants) are measured on their OWN raw structure edge-signals; (T2) INDICATOR variants are measured as LEVEL confirmations layered on the three REGISTERED baseline structures (MSS_L5, FVG_3BAR, SFP_LOOK20), exactly as the L0073/L0077 lineage. rise_start_coverage is computed uniformly for every variant from its own long-direction signal presence near rise starts.
measurement_model.confirmation_form: LEVEL state of the indicator condition at decision bar i (matches L0073/74/76/77 lineage; edge/cross form would collapse coverage). Difference vs L0072 registered TRIGGERS (edge/cross events I01-I14) recorded here.
measurement_model.causality: every value at bar i uses data <= i only; rolling look-backs on shifted/completed bars where noted

signal_coverage.indicator_variant: confirmed_valid / raw_structure_valid, pooled over the 3 baseline structures
signal_coverage.structure_variant: variant_valid / registered_same_family_baseline_valid (ratio; may exceed 1 for looser look-backs)

measurement_model.rise_start_coverage: qualifying rise-starts preceded by the variant's long signal within PRE=3 bars (at or before the start) / all qualifying rise-starts. Rise start = L0073 definition: on base long config, a new run of positive_before_negative outcomes with >=6 bar gap since the previous start.
two_required_lists: top raw directional accuracy regardless of sample size
top directional accuracy among variants with sufficient sample (decided>=100) and documented coverage

locked_signal_definitions.note: All thresholds locked BEFORE measurement. Differences vs L0072 registered defs are recorded in 'diffs_vs_registered'. No post-hoc thresholds; no values added after seeing results.

MACD.signal_period: recorded in catalog, not used by the level trigger (registered I05 logic = line vs zero)

BB.family_note: Bollinger and Z-Score are ONE family; z=+/-2 with p=20 equals BB_20_2.0. No separate Z candidate.

diffs_vs_registered: RSI7 threshold: L0072 registers RSI_FAST=7 but no threshold for it; locked to classic 30/70 (only registered numbers reused; RSI2 keeps registered 15/85).
MFI/CMF longer lengths (20/30) reuse the registered 20/80 and >0/<0 bands; only the window changes.
OBV variants use SMA(obv,n) per the task grid names (OBV_SMA10/20/50); registered I09 used EMA(obv,20). Deliberate parameter variant.
BB replaces the registered Z-score/BB level as (period,mult) grid; BB_20_2.0 long == registered z<=-2 with p=20.
ADX/DI threshold fixed at registered ADX_TREND=22; L0077 had used 20. Period varies 14/20/28.
Confirmation form is LEVEL state at bar i (registered I01-I14 are edge/cross events).

vpfr.reason: no source file or settings provided by the user; per task, do NOT invent a variant. Recorded in catalog, not run.

random_control.indicator_variant: resample decided baseline-structure outcomes at k = confirmed count (L0077 style)
random_control.structure_variant: resample eligible-bar outcomes within each symbol's signal range at k = fire count (L0073 style)

validity_note: Selection reports accuracy, sample size, coverage and Wilson together. High accuracy with collapsed coverage / tiny n is NOT treated as success. Sufficient-sample gate for list 2: decided>=100.
checks_section8: each variant_id has a registered setting
VPFR uses no manual range chosen after seeing a chart
